description: Java class defining REST API endpoints for managing likelihood data related to surveys. Includes methods for retrieving all likelihood entries, retrieving a specific likelihood by ID, and updating likelihood data. Uses JAX-RS annotations and integrates with Spring components.

classes.name: LikelihoodApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing endpoints to access and modify likelihood data associated with survey parameters, secured by user permissions.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all likelihood data entries for a given 'ppiName'. Validates user permissions, calls the read service, and serializes the response to JSON.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Handles GET requests for specific likelihood data by ID and 'ppiName'. Validates permissions, retrieves data from the read service, and serializes to JSON.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update likelihood data for a specific ID and 'ppiName'. Validates permissions, wraps the JSON request into a command, executes the command via the command service, and returns the result.
